protocol: The acquisition stage searches GEO, ArrayExpress, ENA and the catalogues of controlled-access repositories with fixed terms for studies released up to the census date, stores every response unmodified, and keeps every record found in the census with a status. It harvests the study and sample records of every candidate study and downloads the expression files of the included studies with their SHA-256 checksums; a rebuild reads these stored answers and asks the repositories again only on request.

undated.ega: OmicsDI records of EGA carry no publication date
undated.dbgap: OmicsDI records of dbGaP carry no publication date
undated.ena: a child study reached through the runs of a matched umbrella project has no study record of its own

dataset_types: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing

ena.matching: Quoted phrase on study title and description; single-word terms are also matched as substrings because ENA wildcards do not span words.

eligibility.decided: Screening decides which studies are downloaded; roles, patients and samples are decided at the cohort stage.
eligibility.unit: The resource keeps every sample of an included study; repeated deposits of one sample and repeated samples of one patient are marked at the cohort stage, with one sample marked for every patient.
eligibility.study: A study is eligible when at least one of its samples meets every sample criterion and comes from a patient with sepsis. Other samples in the same study do not affect the decision.

sample.assay: Transcriptome-wide mRNA expression by microarray or bulk RNA sequencing
tissue: total blood leukocytes or buffy coat
excluded: purified or sorted cell populations, extracellular vesicles, plasma or serum RNA
non-blood tissue, cell lines and organoids
samples cultured, stimulated or treated outside the body

eligibility.sepsis: Sepsis, severe sepsis or septic shock as diagnosed by the source study, at any age. The definition a study used is recorded, not re-adjudicated. Bacteraemia, pneumonia, COVID-19, influenza or critical illness count only where the study itself calls the patient septic. Human experimental endotoxaemia is not sepsis.

roles.sepsis: Patient with sepsis, severe sepsis or septic shock
roles.sirs: Non-infectious systemic inflammation or critical illness
roles.infection_without_sepsis: Infected patient whom the study does not call septic

eligibility.comparators: SIRS, healthy and infection-without-sepsis samples are retained only from studies that also contribute sepsis patients.
eligibility.repeat_samples: When a patient has several samples all are kept with their time point; the cohort stage marks the earliest, so that one sample per patient can be selected with a single flag.
eligibility.age: All ages are retained and labelled neonate, paediatric or adult.
eligibility.raw_reads: Studies available only as raw sequencing reads are not quantified in this version. They are excluded and documented with the reason raw_reads_only.
eligibility.later_versions: Studies excluded as controlled_access, no_public_reads or raw_reads_only pass the scientific criteria and are candidates for a later version of the resource.

screening.method: Each candidate study has one recorded decision, the first reason that holds in the order of the reasons, and every decision is checked against the harvested records; the technology of a study is the one its sample records name.

reasons.not_a_dataset: The record is not a study or dataset, for example a data access committee entry.
reasons.third_party_reanalysis: A series that reanalyses the samples of another series and owns none of its own.
reasons.not_transcriptome_wide_mrna: No transcriptome-wide mRNA measurement by microarray or bulk RNA sequencing: microRNA or other small RNA only, methylation, chromatin, genotype or exome, protein, cell-free DNA, or a targeted gene panel.
reasons.single_cell: Every expression profile is single-cell or single-nucleus.
reasons.not_blood: No sample is whole blood, total leukocytes or PBMC.
reasons.sorted_cells: Blood-derived, but every sample is a purified or sorted cell population, extracellular vesicles, or plasma or serum RNA.
reasons.ex_vivo_stimulated: Every blood sample was cultured, stimulated or treated outside the body.
reasons.no_sepsis_patients: No eligible blood sample comes from a patient the study itself diagnoses with sepsis.
reasons.superseries_of_included_subseries: A GEO SuperSeries whose samples all belong to included studies.
reasons.overlaps_included_study: Shares samples with an included study that is the preferred unit, named in overlaps_with.
reasons.controlled_access: Passes the scientific criteria as far as the public record shows, but is held under controlled access.
reasons.no_public_reads: Passes the scientific criteria and is registered in ENA or SRA, but its reads are not public.
reasons.raw_reads_only: Passes the scientific criteria and is public, but exists only as raw sequencing reads with no expression matrix in a repository.
reasons.no_expression_files: Passes the scientific criteria, but the repository holds the sample table without any raw or processed expression file.
reasons.no_usable_expression_values: Passes the scientific criteria, but its deposited expression files cannot be read into comparable values for its samples.
reasons.eligible: Meets every study criterion and is openly available as expression data.

recall.basis: Every GEO and ArrayExpress cohort used by one of three published multi-cohort analyses of sepsis transcriptomes whose own record names sepsis: Sweeney et al. 2015, Sci Transl Med 7:287ra71 (doi 10.1126/scitranslmed.aaa5993; discovery and validation cohorts); Sweeney et al. 2018, Crit Care Med 46:915-925 (doi 10.1097/CCM.0000000000003084; discovery and validation cohorts); and Sweeney et al. 2018, Nat Commun 9:694 (doi 10.1038/s41467-018-03078-2; discovery and community-acquired validation cohorts). Reaching a cohort does not include it; screening decides each study on its records, and the recall result is in the census receipt (recall).

outside_scope.basis: Cohorts of the same analyses whose study records never name sepsis, so that the eligibility rule cannot take them as sepsis studies; the search is not expected to reach them, and the stored search of 2026-10-11 (search.json) reaches none of them.
